QuestInfo.name: Aran's Awakening
QuestInfo.1: Lilin said that the Empress Cygnus will help boost the powers of the Resistance, and so might also be able to help you regain some lost power. You should bring some Epidote from the mysterious mine to the Empress at the Conference Pavillion.
QuestInfo.2: Through the combined powers of the Epidote and Empress Cygnus, your potential has been unlocked! Behold your awesome power!
